result.description: Boram Tiling Pty Ltd   Construction Estimator    Boram Tiling Pty Ltd    Position: Full-time, permanent (38 hours per week)       Salary: $90,000 - $95,000 base salary + Superannuation    Location: Strathfield NSW 2135    About the Role   We are seeking an experienced Construction Estimator to join our pre-construction team on a permanent full-time basis. The successful applicant will play a key role in preparing accurate cost estimates and competitive tenders for commercial and residential construction projects, with a particular focus on tiling and waterproofing trade packages.  Reporting to the Director, you will work closely with project managers, suppliers, subcontractors and clients to ensure accurate pricing and successful tender submissions.   How to apply   Please submit your CV and a cover letter outlining your relevant construction estimating experience and suitability for the role. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities    Prepare detailed cost estimates and quantity take-offs for commercial and residential construction projects, particularly tiling and waterproofing trade packages.  Analyse project conditions, trade scopes, installation requirements and site factors to determine labour, material, equipment and preliminary costs.  Measure quantities and prepare material take-offs using estimating software such as Bluebeam and Cubit Estimating.  Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings, specifications and contract documentation.  Liaise with builders, suppliers, subcontractors and internal project teams to obtain quotations and technical information.  Conduct site inspections where required to verify measurements, access conditions and installation requirements.  Prepare pricing schedules, cost breakdowns, estimate summaries and tender submissions.  Assist with compiling tender documentation and supporting estimate analyses.  Participate in tender clarification meetings and respond to pricing queries.  Ensure estimates are commercially competitive while complying with project specifications and contractual requirements.       Qualification & experience   Requirements    Must have a bachelor’s degree or higher in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Building and Construction Estimating, or Quantity Surveying.  At least 3 years of relevant fulltime experience as a construction estimator.  Demonstrated experience preparing estimates for commercial or residential construction projects.   Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings and specifications.   Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills.   Experience using construction estimating software and Microsoft Excel.   Excellent communication and organisational skills with strong attention to detail.   Ability to manage multiple tenders and work effectively within deadlines.   Previous experience estimating tiling, waterproofing or specialist finishes packages will be highly regarded.   About Company     About Us  Boram Tiling Pty Ltd (ABN 42 610 627 364) is one of New South Wales' leading commercial tiling and waterproofing contractors, delivering high-quality solutions across residential, commercial and mixed-use construction projects. Since its establishment, the company has built a strong reputation for professionalism, reliability and exceptional workmanship, becoming the preferred contractor for many builders and developers throughout NSW.  Our expertise spans ceramic tiling and waterproofing, with comprehensive supply and installation services tailored to meet the needs of complex construction projects. We pride ourselves on delivering projects to the highest quality standards while maintaining strong, long-term relationships with our clients through dependable service and consistent results.         Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $90000-95000   Job Publish:  21-07-2026   Job Expire:  20-08-2026  Apply on:  Construction Estimator Job here!
